title: Прострочені звернення
query: SELECT appeal_number, applicant_name, service_name, deadline_date, CAST(JULIANDAY('now') - JULIANDAY(deadline_date) AS INTEGER) as days_overdue FROM grunt_registry_appeal WHERE deadline_date < date('now') AND status NOT IN ('Виконано','Відмовлено','Скасовано') ORDER BY days_overdue DESC
